description.value: Li's China Grill (烤之味) is a Chinese restaurant on Kingsway in Vancouver specializing in grilled fish and Chinese-style BBQ (chuan cuisine). The restaurant offers table reservations through its website and online ordering. It has been described on its own site as a beloved fixture of the Kingsway dining scene, delivering Sichuan-influenced flavours in the heart of the city.
